issue.body:

 - Add-ons:

   - [x] Source Code Disclosure (WEB-INF folder) fails with Java 9+ (#4038)
   - [x] Unable to create reports with Export Report add-on and Java 9+ (#4214)
   - [x] SAML add-on leads to errors with Java 9+ (#5032)
   - [x] Jython [illegal reflective access](https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/issues/2602#issuecomment-564565232) (zaproxy/zap-extensions#2464)
   - [x] Groovy [illegal reflective access](https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/issues/2602#issuecomment-564565232)
   - [x] Report Generation add-on reflective access (https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/issues/2602#issuecomment-947899477)

issue.title: Be more defensive when instantiating add-on class

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Change AddOnLoaderUtils to catch LinkageError when instantiating
declared add-ons classes (ZapAddOn.xml file) to prevent incompatibly
issues in one add-on (class) to affect other add-ons. For example, the
SOAP add-on running in Java 9 (and above) would prevent active scanners
from other add-ons from being added.

Improves #4323.
Related to #4037 - SOAP Scanner add-on leads to errors with Java 9

issue.title: Add Java 9 to Travis CI builds (alpha)
issue.body:
Change .travis.yml to also run the build with Java 9.
Change build.xml file to include a Messages.properties file on the
classpath as it's required by core, also, include add-ons in test
classpath to include helper class (SystemUtils, from commons-lang3).
Disable SOAPActionSpoofingActiveScannerTestCase on Java 9+ because of
class used (i.e. zaproxy/zaproxy#4037).

Part of zaproxy/zaproxy#2602 - Java 9

body: This will be addressed during the migration to Gradle (to avoid pushing more binaries to the repo), by depending on (and thus bundling) the required library.
